senses.gloss: m. (אדר, נדר v. אָדַר) a place cut off, circle (cmp. זִירָה), whence threshing place, barn; also the grain piled up in the barn for threshing; cmp. גּוֹרֶן.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 2:11">Targ. Hos. II, 11</cite> <he>בעידן א׳</he> at the season of its being piled up; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:5">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> the shovel <he>דאפיך אי׳</he> which upturns the grain in the barn (= prayer averting evil decrees).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:5">Ib.</cite> (play on <cite ref="A00479"><he>אדרת</he></cite> <cite ref="Genesis 25:25">Gen. XXV, 25</cite>) <he>כקש מא׳</he> like chaff from the barn.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">Ruth R. to III, 3</cite> <he>להיכן אקימתא א׳</he> where didst thou put up the barn?—Pl. <he>אִידְּרַיָּא</he>, <he>אִדְּרֵי</he> &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 23:1">Targ. I Sam. XXIII, 1</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3:1">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> (homilet. rendition of <he>הסהר אגן</he> Cant. l. c.) <he>א׳ דאזהרה</he> a rounded place (cmp. <cite ref="C00498"><he>גורן</he></cite>, <he>זירה</he>) of enlightenment, i.e. hall of the Sanhedrin. [With <cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite> or <cite ref="N00001"><he>נ</he></cite> rejected: <he>בי דרי</he>.
